episode_title: Tucker Carlson on his MAGA split and Trump's 'nihilism' | NPR's Newsmakers
script_en: Tucker Carlson on his MAGA split and Trump's 'nihilism' | NPR's Newsmakers.
Tucker Carlson is talking about what happened behind closed doors in his very public break with President Trump.
Carlson's theories have raised questions about antisemitism — a charge he denied before being asked.
Carlson also revisits his years as a cable-TV partisan, talks about a possible third party and explains why he believes both major parties have failed Americans.

In response to a request for comment from NPR, the White House did not address Carlson's claims specifically, instead sending along a social media post by the president that describes Carlson and others as "stupid people" who want Iran to have a nuclear weapon.
